pkgmetadata.longdescription: WinBoat is an Electron application that runs Windows inside a Docker or Podman container (dockur/windows) and composites Windows apps onto the Linux desktop with FreeRDP RemoteApp. This package installs the upstream amd64 prebuilt binary; it does not build the Electron app from source.

use.flag: Install Docker Engine, Docker CLI, and Docker Compose v2 for the default container runtime
Install Podman and podman-compose as an alternate container runtime
